meta.title: darktable editing universe taxonomy
meta.id_convention: id = darktable iop op name (as in XMP darktable:operation) where one exists; mask_* and neural_restore are non-iop
meta.typical ranges: practitioner working ranges, not hard slider limits; derived from manual + tutorials, medium confidence

modules.plain_words: Sets the sensor's black and white levels so the raw data starts from true zero. Almost never touched unless a camera is mis-profiled.
Turns the single-colour sensor mosaic into full RGB pixels; 5.4 adds capture sharpening here to undo sensor/AA blur.

params.name: dual demosaic threshold
phrases: smooth flat areas, keep detail on edges

modules.plain_words: Finds and removes stuck or hot sensor pixels, common in long exposures.
phrases: get rid of the red/green dots in the long exposure

modules.plain_words: Rebuilds colour and detail in areas where one or more sensor channels clipped; default inpaint opposed.

params.name: method
params.unit: enum inpaint opposed|segmentation based|guided laplacians|clip highlights|reconstruct in LCh

params.name: clipping threshold
phrases: mask doesn't match the overexposure warning

modules.plain_words: Removes lateral colour fringes at raw level (Bayer only), before demosaic.
phrases: remove colour fringing at raw level

modules.plain_words: Removes purple/green fringes along high-contrast edges after demosaic; works on any sensor.
phrases: get rid of the colour fringes on the branches

modules.plain_words: Wavelet noise reduction on raw data before demosaic; rarely used vs denoise (profiled).
Rotates by 90-degree steps or flips; applied from EXIF automatically.

params.name: orientation
params.unit: enum no rotation|flip H|flip V|rotate 90 CW|rotate 90 CCW|rotate 180

modules.plain_words: Raw-level channel multipliers. In the modern scene-referred workflow it stays at 'camera reference' and colour calibration does the real white balance.

params.name: setting
params.unit: enum as shot|camera reference|user modified|as shot to reference|preset

modules.plain_words: Sets overall brightness (the mid-grey point) in stops; also the dodge/burn workhorse when masked.

params.name: black level correction
phrases: don't use to crush blacks (manual says use the tone mapper)

params.name: area exposure mapping target
phrases: match the brightness across the set

modules.plain_words: Scene-to-display tone mapper with an S-curve; fewer knobs than filmic; default tone mapper for new installs since 5.2.
Blender-derived tone mapper added in 5.4: exposure range, pivot, contrast, toe/shoulder power, plus look slope/lift/brightness/saturation and primaries for film-like highlight desaturation.
modules.notes: Presets: blender-like|base, scene-referred default, smooth, punchy, unmodified.

modules.plain_words: Original scene-referred tone mapper (Aurelien Pierre): white/black relative exposure, contrast, latitude, highlight reconstruction; still default in older configs.
Display-referred camera-JPEG-like curve; legacy / display-referred workflow and camera styles; exposure fusion for pseudo-HDR.
Dodges and burns by brightness zone using a smoothed luminance mask, like a graphic equalizer for light: pull the sky down, lift faces in shadow, without halos.

params.name: preserve details
params.unit: enum no|guided filter|averaged guided filter|eigf|averaged eigf

modules.notes: Presets: compress shadows/highlights (gf/eigf) soft/medium/strong, relight. Set mask with the wand buttons first.

modules.plain_words: Curve on RGB (linked or per channel) for creative contrast shaping and colour casts; works in scene-referred space.

params.name: preserve colors
params.unit: enum none|luminance|max RGB|average RGB|sum RGB|norm|basic power

modules.plain_words: Black/grey/white level pickers on RGB, linked or per channel.
Legacy Lab/RGB curve module; display-referred habit, still used for per-channel Lab curves.
Legacy display-referred local lift/compress; prone to halos, superseded by tone equalizer.
Simulated graduated ND filter: darkens part of the frame with a linear gradient, optionally tinted.
The modern white balance (chromatic adaptation) plus channel mixer, colourfulness/brightness per channel, and grey tab for B&W; can calibrate from a colour checker.

params.name: illuminant
params.unit: enum as shot in camera|daylight|blackbody|custom|A|D50|D65|F...|detect from surfaces|detect from edges

modules.notes: Mixed light: one instance per illuminant with drawn/parametric masks; second instance reuses the first mask inverted via raster mask.

modules.plain_words: The main colour grading tool: global vibrance/chroma/saturation/brilliance, per-zone (shadows/mid/highlights) saturation and brilliance, 4-ways lift/power/gain/offset hue+chroma wheels.
modules.notes: Presets: basic colorfulness (natural/vibrant/standard), add basic colorfulness. Pierre's rule of thumb: chroma globally, saturation in shadows/mids, brilliance in highlights.

modules.plain_words: Hue-selective hue/saturation/brightness curves (HSL-style) in darktable UCS; the modern replacement for color zones.
Older hue/chroma/lightness curves in LCh; still widely used for selective colour and selective desaturation.
Rotates hue and purity of the R, G, B primaries (a friendly channel mixer); before tone mapping for colorimetry, after it for tints.
phrases: make it look like film colours

modules.plain_words: Boost muted colours more than already-saturated ones. Standalone vibrance module is deprecated; use color balance rgb global vibrance or velvia.
Saturation boost that protects already saturated pixels; display-referred.
'Saturation' requests map to color balance rgb saturation/chroma; old contrast-brightness-saturation module was removed in 5.2.
Applies a 3D LUT (.cube, .3dl, .png haldclut, .gmz) for film looks or client grades; clips to [0,1]; LUT file lives in the LUT root folder, not the XMP.
Maps colour-checker patches to targets; used for camera-matching and styles (5.0 added an expanded checker preset).
Tints shadows and highlights with two hues; display-referred; color balance rgb 4-ways is the scene-referred equivalent.
Overlays a single solid colour tint; for toned monochrome.
(5.6+) Pulls off-palette hues toward a harmony rule (complementary, triad, etc.) in UCS space; NOT on Scouter's 5.4.1 host.
(dev manual, post-5.6) Saturation and brilliance remapped as curves of input saturation; NOT on 5.4.1 host.

params.name: saturation curve
phrases: protect vivid colours, boost dull ones

modules.plain_words: Noise reduction tuned to each camera/ISO profile; non-local means or wavelets; defaults usually enough.

params.name: mode
params.unit: enum wavelets auto|non-local means auto|wavelets|non-local means

modules.plain_words: Non-local means denoise with separate luma/chroma sliders; used for night skies and heavy noise.
Classic unsharp mask; legacy, meant to undo AA-filter softness; many turn it off in favour of diffuse or sharpen.
Physics-based diffusion engine; its presets do lens deblur, sharpening, dehaze, local contrast, bloom, denoise, inpaint highlights, watercolour.

params.name: preset
params.unit: enum sharpen demosaicing (AA/no AA)|lens deblur soft/medium/hard|dehaze|local contrast|fast sharpness|fast local contrast|bloom|denoise fine/medium/coarse|inpaint highlights|surface blur|simulate watercolor|simulate line drawing

modules.plain_words: Quick detail/clarity boost (local laplacian); just enabling it or picking a preset is often enough.
Wavelet contrast/denoise by feature size: fine texture vs large structure; 'clarity' preset is a popular clarity/structure move.
One-slider dehaze using a dark-channel prior; negative strength adds haze.
(dev manual, post-5.6) Scene-referred local contrast via eigf; NOT on 5.4.1 host.
High-pass layer, blended (overlay/soft light) for sharpening.
Low-pass blur; with blend modes used for soft glow, local contrast inversion, or shadow recovery tricks.
Edge-preserving bilateral blur; chroma blend reduces moire or skin redness.
Auto-detects lens (Lensfun or embedded metadata) and fixes distortion, vignetting and TCA; enable before exposure since it changes brightness.
Straightens horizons and fixes converging verticals (keystone), with auto structure detection; right-drag along the horizon to level.
Crops to a region with aspect ratio presets and composition guides.
phrases: cut out the distraction at the edge

modules.plain_words: Push/pull/warp pixels with points, lines, curves; bulge/pinch.
Clone, heal, fill, blur with drawn shapes; wavelet decomposition gives frequency-separation skin retouching. Source is manual (no content-aware).
Legacy clone-only spot tool; deprecated in favour of retouch.
Creative vignette (darken/brighten edges, desaturate) with shape and centre controls; add dither to avoid banding.
Adds film-like grain (luminance only) scaled by simulated ISO coarseness.
Adds a coloured border/frame with aspect ratio and position; a frame line too.
Overlays an SVG/PNG watermark with variable text (e.g. $(EXIF.DATE), copyright).
Lens (bokeh), motion or gaussian blur; used masked to fake shallow depth or motion.
Glow around highlights (Lab, display-referred); diffuse-or-sharpen bloom preset is the scene-referred alternative.
Orton-style soft glow by blending a blurred, brightened copy.
Quick Lab B&W with a movable colour filter; the color calibration gray tab is the preferred modern method.
Inverts and corrects scanned colour/B&W film negatives (Aurelien Pierre).
Refills colour into clipped white areas from neighbours; mostly superseded by highlight reconstruction/filmic.
Adds tiny noise to prevent banding in smooth gradients (skies, vignettes) on 8-bit export.
Pixelates/blurs a masked area (faces, plates).
Adds canvas around the image (e.g. for a frame or text).
Hand-drawn circles, ellipses, paths, brushes, gradients attached to any module; combine with set operations.
Select pixels by channel ranges (L, chroma, hue, g, R/G/B, Jz etc.) on input and output; the luminosity-mask equivalent.
Reuse the final mask of an earlier module in a later one (and 5.2 adds external PFM raster masks with refine controls).
phrases: apply to everything except the subject

modules.plain_words: Click-to-segment subject mask (SAM2.1/SegNext), vectorised into editable paths; optional, disabled by default, needs AI build and models. NOT on 5.4.1 host.
AI raw denoise, denoise and upscale (NIND UNet, RawNIND, RealPLKSR) with strength slider; optional AI build only. NOT on 5.4.1 host.

bulk.name: import_and_cull
steps: import (add to library / copy & import)
culling mode X (fixed) or ctrl+X (dynamic) side-by-side with synced zoom
rate 0-5 via number keys, R to reject, F1-F5 colour labels
filter collection by rating/label
group bursts, pick best of group

bulk.name: hero_then_propagate
steps: primary grade on each image first (exposure, color calibration / checker profile) so all are neutral
edit a reference (hero) image
selective copy the secondary grade (tone mapper, color balance rgb, looks)
selective paste in APPEND mode so per-image primary grade survives
fine-tune per image: area exposure mapping to a control sample, tone-mapper white picker, color calibration area mapping
if background changed, add a later-instance secondary tweak rather than altering the shared grade

bulk.name: copy_paste_history
steps: ctrl+C / ctrl+V copies full stack in append mode
ctrl+shift+C / ctrl+shift+V selective copy/paste dialog
full copy excludes orientation, lens correction, raw black/white point, rotate pixels, scale pixels, white balance and deprecated modules unless selectively pasted
overwrite mode irrevocably replaces the target history
compress history / discard history are not undoable

bulk.name: styles
steps: create style from history stack (choose modules, optionally 'reset' a module)
name with '|' for hierarchy e.g. 'client|warm portrait'
apply by double-click or shortcut, append or overwrite, optionally onto a duplicate
chain several styles by applying in append mode in order
export/import .dtstyle XML to share
camera styles group (5.0+) approximates camera JPEG looks for 500+ bodies; auto-apply via Lua script official/camera style

bulk.name: module_presets
steps: save module settings as preset from the hamburger menu
auto-apply presets by camera/lens/ISO/format filters (e.g. lens correction, denoise per ISO)
presets hierarchical via '|' since 5.2
auto presets only apply on first darkroom open or after history discard

bulk.name: batch_export_profiles
steps: export module presets: web (JPEG, long edge 2048, sRGB, quality 85-92), print (TIFF 16-bit, AdobeRGB/ProPhoto, full size), client proof (JPEG 1600px + watermark style)
filename templates with variables like $(FILE_NAME)_$(SEQUENCE)
style applied at export time (append) e.g. watermark or sharpen-for-web
5.2+: multi-preset export in one go
darktable-cli for headless export with an XMP/style

bulk.name: sidecar_handling
steps: XMP sidecar per image (name.ext.xmp) written on every history change by default
duplicates get _01, _02 sidecars
look for updated XMP on startup (preference) to pick up external edits
load sidecar file / write sidecar files in history stack module
exported files embed history; can be loaded back as a sidecar

bulk.name: outlier_handling
steps: sort edited set by exposure/time, view in culling or filmstrip
outliers (different light) get area exposure mapping + color calibration area mapping to the memorised control sample
if still off, extra later instance of the grading module rather than editing the shared one
flag with colour label for review

bulk.name: time_lapse_deflicker
steps: exposure module automatic mode (percentile + target level) pasted to all frames to deflicker

cannot_do.intent: generative fill / add or invent content
cannot_do.why: darktable has no generative model; retouch only clones/heals from a user-chosen source
cannot_do.right_response: Refuse generative content; offer retouch clone/heal for small removals, or recommend a raster editor (GIMP, Photoshop) for the rest.

cannot_do.intent: content-aware removal of large objects (people, cars, poles across the frame)
cannot_do.why: retouch has no content-aware/resynthesizer mode (open feature request #15006); needs a manual source region, poor on large areas
cannot_do.right_response: Say it only works for small, simple backgrounds; offer clone/heal on small spots; suggest an external editor for big removals.

cannot_do.why: no layer compositing of another image into masked areas (composite module overlays a whole image, no sky-aware masking on 5.4.1)
cannot_do.right_response: Refuse replacement; offer to improve the existing sky (tone equalizer, graduated density, colour equalizer blue, haze removal).

cannot_do.intent: AI subject / sky / person masks on 5.4.1
cannot_do.why: AI object mask exists only in 5.6+ with an optional AI build, disabled by default; not on the Scouter host
cannot_do.right_response: Use drawn + parametric masks; explain AI masking needs darktable 5.6 with AI enabled.

cannot_do.why: neural restore arrived in 5.6 optional AI build
cannot_do.right_response: Use denoise (profiled)/astrophoto denoise; say upscaling isn't available on this version.

cannot_do.intent: face/body reshaping automatically, face-aware portrait sliders
cannot_do.why: no face detection; liquify is manual point/line warps
cannot_do.right_response: Offer manual liquify with explicit points or decline.

cannot_do.intent: automatic HDR merge of brackets / panorama stitching / focus stacking
cannot_do.why: darktable only has a basic 'create HDR' DNG merge in lighttable (same-framing raws); no panorama or focus stacking
cannot_do.right_response: Offer create-HDR for aligned brackets; recommend Hugin (pano) or external stacking tools; then edit the result.

cannot_do.intent: text/graphic design, adding shapes or typography beyond a watermark
cannot_do.why: only watermark (SVG/PNG with variables) and framing
cannot_do.right_response: Offer watermark/frame; otherwise a design tool.

cannot_do.intent: change the time of day, relight a scene, move the sun
cannot_do.why: no generative relighting; only tonal/colour adjustments
cannot_do.right_response: Offer warm grade + tone equalizer to suggest golden hour; say true relighting is impossible.

cannot_do.intent: remove motion blur / fix missed focus substantially
cannot_do.why: diffuse or sharpen lens deblur recovers mild softness only
cannot_do.right_response: Try lens deblur preset, set expectations that missed focus can't be recovered.

cannot_do.intent: recover fully clipped highlights with real detail
cannot_do.why: reconstruction disguises clipped areas plausibly, cannot recover absent data
cannot_do.right_response: Apply highlight reconstruction and explain the limit.

cannot_do.intent: remove reflections / glare from glasses automatically
cannot_do.right_response: Manual retouch clone/heal only; decline if large.

cannot_do.intent: swap faces / change expressions / open closed eyes
cannot_do.why: no generative or face tools; also sensitive manipulation
cannot_do.right_response: Decline; suggest choosing another frame from the burst.
